note: These review questions were drafted by Claude for development and testing only. They must be rewritten by Addison Robertson (subject-matter expert) before any teacher use. Do not treat them as validated guidance.

criteria.question: Does the material state what students will learn or be able to do, in a way the teacher could check?
criteria.search_query: clear learning objective for reading instruction lesson goals

criteria.question: Does the material build academic language, such as vocabulary, inferential talk, or retelling events in order?
criteria.search_query: teach academic language inferential narrative language vocabulary

criteria.question: Does the material help students hear and work with the sounds in spoken words, and connect those sounds to letters?
criteria.search_query: phonemic awareness segment blend sounds link to letters

criteria.question: Does the material teach students to decode words and recognize common spelling patterns or word parts?
criteria.search_query: teach students to decode words analyze word parts sound-spelling patterns

criteria.question: Is new skill instruction explicit (modeled by the teacher) and part of a planned sequence?
Do students read connected text with support, such as reading aloud with feedback or repeated reading?
criteria.search_query: read connected text daily guided oral reading feedback fluency

criteria.question: Does the material help students read for meaning, such as checking understanding or discussing the text?
criteria.search_query: reading for understanding comprehension monitor meaning

criteria.question: Are there chances for students to practice with the teacher giving prompts, scaffolds, or corrective feedback?
criteria.search_query: guided practice scaffolding corrective feedback word reading

criteria.question: Does the material include a way to see whether students learned the skill?
criteria.search_query: assess student progress monitor reading skills

criteria.question: Which Mississippi College- and Career-Readiness Standards for English Language Arts does the material address for this grade?
criteria.search_query: Mississippi College and Career Readiness Standards English Language Arts foundational skills grade
